attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on RHEL 9. Demonstrated primary failure: stopped node1, verified node2 had zero data loss, promoted node2 to writable primary, repointed node3 to replicate from node2, then rebuilt node1 as a standby of node2 via pg_basebackup. Final topology: node2 primary, node1/node3 standbys, all data consistent. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot_id/uptime and full post-restart health/data/replication recovery on each.
